shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null || echo "NO DOCS DIR"
find app lib __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "--- next.config ---" && cat next.config.ts && echo "--- tsconfig ---" && cat tsconfig.json
grep -ril "view.transition\|viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -30
cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md
grep -A 40 -i "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -70

node -e "const r=require('react'); console.log('react version:', r.version); console.log('ViewTransition:', typeof r.ViewTransition); console.log('addTransitionType:', typeof r.addTransitionType)" 2>&1 | head -20
cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40 && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/

ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/ | grep -i "^react" | head -20; echo "---"; grep -o "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "--- experimental? ---"; ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- grep vendored ---"; grep -rlo "unstable_ViewTransition\|ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react*/cjs/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -10
grep -i -B3 -A 25 "view.transition\|viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/interactive-apps.md | head -80
grep -rn "viewTransition\|view transition\|ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md | head -20

grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== next-env / global types ==="; ls node_modules/next/*.d.ts; grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/types/*.d.ts node_modules/next/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== link types ==="; grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rln "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/ --include="*.d.ts" | head -20; echo "=== types/react check for canary types ==="; grep -rn "\"@types/react\"\|types/react" node_modules/next/package.json | head; echo "=== any react-experimental types? ==="; ls node_modules/@types/react/ ; echo "=== canary d.ts ==="; grep -rn "experimental" node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts | head -5
grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts node_modules/@types/react/experimental.d.ts | head -20
sed -n 30,120p node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts

sed -n 1,30p node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts; echo "=== next-env exists? ==="; ls -la /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>&1; echo "=== does next write canary ref? ==="; grep -rn "react/canary\|next-env.d.ts" node_modules/next/dist/lib/typescript/writeAppTypeDeclarations.js 2>/dev/null | head
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npx next dev --port 3111 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 12; curl -s localhost:3111 -o /tmp/home.html -w "home:%{http_code}\n"; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers -o /tmp/detail.html -w "detail:%{http_code}\n"; grep -o "product-image\|product-hero\|view-transition[^\"]*" /tmp/home.html /tmp/detail.html | sort | uniq -c

ls /root/.cache/ms-playwright /home/vercel-sandbox/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer" ; echo "exit-check-done"

grep -o 'view-transition-name[^;"]*' /tmp/detail.html /tmp/home.html | head; echo "=== hero context ==="; grep -o '.\{120\}product-hero.\{120\}' /tmp/detail.html; echo "=== dev log errors ==="; grep -i "error\|warn\|⨯" /tmp/dev.log | head -20; echo "(end)"

grep -o '.\{60\}vt-name="product-image-classic-sneakers".\{20\}' /tmp/home.html; echo "=== nav wrappers (vt-enter/vt-exit) ==="; grep -o 'vt-enter="[^"]*"\|vt-exit="[^"]*"' /tmp/home.html /tmp/detail.html | sort | uniq -c
grep -o 'nav-forward[^,]\{0,40\}' /tmp/home.html | head -6; echo "=== back link ==="; grep -o 'nav-back[^,]\{0,40\}' /tmp/detail.html | head -6
pkill -f "next dev" ; sleep 1; git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig diff ===" && git diff tsconfig.json
git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff -- tsconfig.json
cat /workspace/.gitignore

npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -10; echo "tsc exit: $?"; echo "=== build ==="; npx next build 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|warn|reconfigured|Compiled|Finished TypeScript|✓" | head -20; echo "=== tsconfig untouched? ==="; git diff --stat -- tsconfig.json
git --no-pager diff -- app/ && echo "=== new files ===" && cat lib/view-transitions.ts react-canary.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TYPECHECK OK"
